name: canva-grid
title: Visual Design Tool
description: Create visual designs — social posts, ads, presentations, stories, and more.
audience: Social media managers, small business owners, students, side-project founders, and anyone who needs polished visuals without learning professional design software or paying for a subscription.
useCases: A freelancer needs an Instagram carousel for a client by tomorrow — picks a layout, drops in product photos, adds text, and exports all pages as PNGs
A student puts together a group presentation — creates a multi-page deck with consistent styling without installing PowerPoint
A small bakery owner makes a weekly specials flyer — uploads food photos, adds prices and a logo, and downloads it to print or post online
A side-project founder needs a Product Hunt launch graphic — starts from a preset theme, swaps in screenshots and copy, and has a polished image in minutes

dataPrivacy.storage: Designs are created in the browser. Images are loaded from a CDN or uploaded locally.
dataPrivacy.thirdParty: Sample images served from canva-grid-assets CDN.
